scope: Natural pretrained-model architecture-bridge-v1 primary experiment, with separately recorded superseded costs. No new inference or training was performed to construct this manifest.
cost_interpretation: seconds is the sum of record-local elapsed durations, not total elapsed wall-clock for the project or sum of last-run.json seconds. Concurrent execution, model loading, orchestration and failed work make those quantities different.

Every primary case JSON and every primary learning complete.json is counted exactly once. Existing superseded cases and superseded complete.json are counted separately; progress.json and checkpoints are not counted again.

Forward FLOPs use 2*P*input_tokens. Backward FLOPs use 4*P*backward_input_tokens as a full-gradient upper proxy although upstream parameters were frozen. Attention/recurrent-cache overhead is excluded.
Recorded successful case/episode costs exclude the unknown failed attempt cost, downloads, installations and separate model preflights. They therefore are not a complete end-to-end expenditure.
FP32 parameter bytes count only loaded text parameters, excluding activations, caches, gradients, optimizer, allocator reservation and unused checkpoint vision weights.

GPU peaks are observed allocated bytes from available last-run snapshots. Missing overwritten process snapshots prevent a claim that they are the exact all-process historical maximum. Do not sum GPU peaks.
